'''''Herniaria maritima''''' is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the family [[Caryophyllaceae]], [[endemic]] to coastal [[Portugal]]. It inhabits coastal dunes, mainly in clearings of creeping forests and [[Junipers]] in fixed dunes, on sandy, neutral or basic substrates.<ref name="iucn status 19 November 2021" />
